description: Search the Corte di cassazione sentences (civil snciv and criminal snpen, 2021 onwards, ItalGiure). Hybrid mode fuses full-text (italian) and vector ranking with reciprocal rank fusion. LEGAL POSTURE: the full text is never returned; each hit gives the extremes (source_id, ecli, kind, sezione, anno, num_dec, data_decisione, materia, tipo_prov), a short highlight or passage (headline, snippet, at most 1500 characters) and the source_url to read the sentence at ItalGiure. An ecli is not unique (civil and criminal sentences can share one): source_id identifies a sentence. Parameters: query (web-search syntax), k (1..50, default 20), mode (hybrid, lexical, semantic), filters kind (snciv, snpen), anno_from and anno_to (deposit year; anno_from must not exceed anno_to), sezione and materia (exact, case-sensitive). With no query the newest decisions are listed first (filters narrow the list; a call without any parameter lists the newest). Example: {"query": "recesso giusta causa", "kind": "snciv", "anno_from": 2023}.
